name: html-aspect-ratio-container-definite-height
description: Two cards whose media box is `width:100%;height:100%` over a `position:absolute;inset:0` cover image. The first card sizes itself with `aspect-ratio:3/2` and a 100% width, so its block size is definite and the media box's `height:100%` genuinely resolves; the second states no size at all, so its own `height:100%` has nothing to resolve against. The projector demotes a structural `height:100%` to `height:auto` only for the second: an `aspect-ratio` box with a definite inline size derives a definite block size the same bottom-up way a grid container derives one from a definite row track, so demoting it collapses the media box to the image's intrinsic ratio and leaves the card half empty.

source_reference.notes: Regression coverage for a sticky card grid whose ratio-sized cards rendered their cover photo at 637x243 instead of filling the card's 637x425 box.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
